name: describe_prefab
description: What a buildable prefab is before it stands anywhere (1.4.3+), in its own frame (unturned, x right, y up, z forward, origin snapped as the cursor snaps it): prefab_name, prefab_hash, display_name, build_states, runtime_type, placement (grid, face or face_mount), grid_size_m, small_grid, rotation_axes (the axes the cursor turns a grid-placed prefab about), allowed_rotations [{facing, up, euler}] (the turns place_structure accepts; a face-mounted piece: every turn, the cursor check decides), small_cells (offsets of the small cells it takes), render_box (the box its meshes fill), grid_box (the small cells' box: its real footprint; null for 2 m structures), ports [{index, type, role, flow in|out|null, at (the joining cell's offset), outward (the way a run leaves)}], visual_up {local (the own axis that reads as its top), lying_allowed, source, verified (true when seen live or forced by the game: the cursor turns it about y only; false: a guess or, for a prefab with no entry that can be built any way up, source ASSUMED, 1.7.0+)}, reversible_flow (turbo volume pumps: Mode 0 and 1 move gas opposite ways), has_cursor and (1.7.0+) controls {local (the own axis its slots, buttons and switches face), votes, considered, source, fallback (true: none of its controls sits clearly on one side, so its forward +z stands in)}, left out for anything that is no device and has no controls. Read only. No gateway is needed.
